data.titulo: Kebebertab 3—Kesoru Israelik eng’ Misri Agoi Laitoriat ne Tai ne bo Israel
data.contenido:
Kiindochi Musa lagokab Israel kong’eete Misri agoi Tulwetab Sinai ole kiigochine Kamuktaindet ng’atutikyik. Kiit kasarta ne kiiyookto Musa segeik 12 koba kogeer emetab Kanan. Nga u noto, ko kiweek 10 ak ng’alek che yaach agobo emetab Kanan. Ki yai nito komach koweek bik emetab Misri. Amu ma iboor lagokab Israel kayanet eng’ Jehovah, ko kergong’ Jehovah ichek kobendat eng’ ong’atet kenyisiek 40.

Ki eng’ let, kelewen Josua kondoochi lagokab Israel agoi Kanan. Ki yai Jehovah kwong’utik si kotoret lagokab Israel koib emetab Kanan koek nenywa. Ki itelel beek che ki rootei eng’ Ainetab Jordan, ki yai kolulyo gorikab Jeriko ak koyai kotonon asista betut komugul. Ki ye ibata kenyisiek lou, koib lagokab Israel emetab Kanan koek nenywa.

Kiindochi kiruogik Israel kenyisiek 356, ago ne ki tai eng’ kiruogichoto ko ki Josua. Kinetigei agobo kiruogik alak che chang’ ko u Barak, Gideon, Jepta, Samson ak Samuel. Kinetigei kora agobo kwonyik che u Rahab, Debora, Jael, Ruth, Naomi ak Delila. Kebebertab SOMOK tugul kong’alalee agobo tuguk che ki yaak eng’ kenyisiek 396.

TOS nee tuguchu romu bichu eng’ ng’ony? Ngegeerei ko u koikab ropta, ago ma koik amu kiame tuguchuto.

Ko kobeg arawet agenge kityo kong’eete ngomong’ lagokab Israel eng’ Misri. Mitei ong’atet nguni ago tutigin amitwogik che rurtos eng’ yuto, ko u noto konaam kong’unyng’unyso bik ak kole: ‘Ki ta kaigai kobarech Jehovah eng’ Misri. Ki kaigai amu ki mi amitwogik tugul che ki kimache.’

Kolenji Jehovah anyun: ‘Arong’wok amitwogik che bunu kipsengwet.’ Ago noto kit ne ki yai Jehovah. Ki ye eech betut ne rubei kogeer lagokab Israel komitei ng’ony tugun che leelach, koteebengei kole: ‘Nee tuguchu?’

Kolenji Musa: ‘Chuto ko amitwogik che kagonok Jehovah oam.’ Koguure bik amitwogichoto MANA. Ki chamu magatiat ne kagitesyi kumiat.

Kilenji Musa bik: ‘Nyolu koyum chi tugul amitwogik che yamei kityo.’ Ki yai ko u noto lagokab Israel kila subui. Ki ye lal asista, kochootyo mana che ki mi ng’ony.

Kile Musa kora: ‘Ma magat kogonor chi mana agoi betut ne rubei.’ Nga u noto, ko ma kas it bik alage. Ingen ile nee ne ki yaak? Eng’ bik che kigonor mana ko kingo eech betut ne rubei, ko kiga konam kutik ak kong’uuto ne samis! Ki mi betut agenge eng’ wigit ne kilenji Jehovah bik koyum mana che bo betusiek aeng’, betunito ko betutab lo. Kilenji Jehovah anyun kogonor che bo betut ne rubei, amu ki ma kogonu mana betutab tisab. Kingo konor agoi betutab tisab, ko maam kutik ago ma ng’uuto ne samis! Kwong’utiet age nito!

Eng’ kenyisiek tugul che ki mi lagokab Israel ong’atet, ko kibae Jehovah mana.Komong’u 16:1-36; Koitosiek 11:7-9; Josua 5:10-12. Teebutik che Kineetengei

KINGO kagobata arawek aeng’u kong’eete kogamanda lagokab Israel eng’ Misri, koit Tulwetab Sinai ne kiguure kora Horeb. Yuto ole ki ng’alaljinen Jehovah Musa eng’ ketit ne ki lalei. Ki bir kambi bik eng’ yuto kasarta kitigin.

Kilaany Musa tulwet, kuure bik alage legemet, kogen bik eng’ tulwet ng’ony. Kingo mi Musa tulwet barak, komwachi Jehovah magennyi ne bo kogas it lagokab Israel inendet ak koek bikyik che itabanotin. Kingoweek Musa, komwachi lagokab Israel agobo tuguk che kamwa Jehovah. Kole bik tugul kasei it tuguk tugul che kamwa Jehovah amu machei ak ichek koek bikyik.

Ki yai anyun Jehovah kiy ne tomo kegeerei. Ki yai Jehovah koiyien anan koarusan tulwet ak kotul tulet ne o. King’alalji kora bik kolenji: ‘A Jehovah Kamuktaindeng’wong’ ne kiimoong’wok eng’ Misri.’ King’at Jehovah lagokab Israel kolenji: ‘Mat osa cheptalelisiek, magat oboisieiywo anege.’

Ki igochi Jehovah lagokab Israel ng’atutik alak sogol. Koarogenso bik ne bo kwong’ut, ak kolenji Musa: ‘Ng’alalwech inyendet, ma kigonye kong’alalwech Jehovah amu kiywei kele ngot kong’alalwech komuch kebegu.’

Kilenji Jehovah Musa anyun: ‘Nyo tulwet barak si agonin koik aeng’ che lebelen che kasirji ng’atutik che amache kosub lagokab Israel.’ Kwo anyun Musa tulwet barak, ak kotebi betusiek 40 bet ak kemoi eng’ oloto.

Ki mi ng’atutik che chang’ che ki igochi Jehovah bikyik. Ki sir Musa ng’atutichoto. Ki igochi kora Jehovah Musa koik aeng’ che lebelen che kigasirji ng’atutik 10, che ki mwae kogasei bik tugul. Kiguuren ng’atutichuto Ng’atutik Taman.

Bo kamanut Ng’atutik Tamanu. Nga u noto, ko bo kamanut kora ng’atutik alage che ki igochi Jehovah lagokab Israel. Agenge eng’ ng’atutichuto ko: ‘Cham Jehovah Kamuktaindeng’ung’ eng’ muguleldang’ung’ komugul, ak eng’ ng’omnateng’ung’ tugul, ak eng’ sobondang’ung’ tugul ak eng’ kimnateng’ung’ tugul.’ Age ko ni: ‘Cham chitab kokweng’ung’ ko u ole ichamdoigei.’ Kimwa Jesu Kristo Weritab Jehovah kole chuto ng’atutik che eechen che ki igochi Jehovah lagokab Israel. Ta kinetigei tuguk che chang’ agobo Weritab Jehovah ak kanetutikyik.Komong’u 19:1-25; 20:1-21; 24:12-18; 31:18; Ne Kibwate Ng’atutik 6:4-6; Atebetab Lawik 19:18; Matayo 22:36-40. Teebutik che Kineetengei

HE HEE! Nee chu yae bichu? Sae moita. Amu nee si kosa moita?

Kingo tebi Musa eng’ tulwet koek keny, konaam kole lagokab Israel: ‘Ma kingen kit ne kogoyaak eng’ Musa. Ongeyachigei cheptalelit si kondoiywech kemande eng’ emoni.’

Koyan anyun tupchetab Musa ne keguuren Aron kit ne kamwa bik, ak kolenji: ‘Onemun tugukab itik che otinye che bo tahabu ak oibwo.’ Kingo kageipchi Aron tuguchoto kobeel kochootyo ak koboisiee kochob moitab tahabu. Kole bik anyun: ‘Kamuktaindennyo ni ne kiimutwech eng’ Misri.’ Koyai anyun lagokab Israel igoorto ne o ak koot moitab tahabu.

Kingo keer Jehovah, konerech ne bo kwong’ut ak kolenji Musa: ‘Rekten ak ichakte amu yae tuguk che yaachen bik. Kogoutye ng’atutikyuk ago kutung’jin moitab tahabu.’ Ki chakta Musa kochortagei eng’ tulwet. Kingo rikyi yoto, kogeer kotiendos ak kourerenjin bik moitab tahabu! Konerech Musa ne bo kwong’ut kot kowirta koiywek aeng’ che lebelen che kiga kisirji ng’atutik koyiesyo. Ki nam moitab tahabu Musa anyun ak kobeel kot kochoot, ak kong’a komengegitu anan kobusbusitu.

Ki yai bik kit ne ya ne bo kwong’ut. Ko u noto, kolewen Musa murenik ak kolenji konam rotokwak bo chok, ak kole: ‘Magat kobeg bik tugul che kogutung’ji moitab tahabu.’ Ki kibar anyun bik 3,000! Tos ma ibooru nito kole nyolu keboisiechi Jehovah inegei, ama magat kesaa cheptalelisiek?Komong’u 32:1-35. Teebutik che Kineetengei

TOS ingen ile bo nee goi? Nito ko emait ne bo kamanut ne kisaeen Jehovah. Ki tar koteechei bik goito kenyit agenge kingo kagomoong’ eng’ Misri. Ingen ile ki ng’o ne ki len keteech?

Ki Jehovah ne ki mwae keteech goito. Kingo mi Musa Tulwetab Sinai, komwachi Jehovah ole kiteektoi. Kilenji koteech eng’ oret ne kimuchi kebut eng’ nyumnyumindo. Eng’ oranito, ko ki kimuchi keib kong’eete komosta age agoi age ak keba keteech kogeny. Ko u noto, ko kiiboti lagokab Israel emainito kingo uuoti eng’ ong’atet.

Keer pichaini, tos igeere rumit ne mining’ eng’ emait orit, ago tos igeere bogisit ne mi ruminoto? Bogisinito keguure moingetab kayonchinet. Kiga kinde taban taban ne bo bogisinito malaikaisiek aeng’ che kiguuree kerubik che ki kagichobee tahabu. Ta ibwati ile kiga tui Musa Ng’atutik Taman che kiga igochi Kamuktaindet? Ko u noto, ko ki yaach kosir Kamuktaindet ng’atutik alak kogeny. Ng’atutichoto ko ki kigonoree moingetab kayonchinet. Ki kigonoree kora mana tutigin moingonoto bo kayonchinet. Tos ta ibwati ile mana ko ki nee?

Ki lewen Jehovah Aron tupchetab Musa koek tisiindet ne o. Kiindochin bik koboisiechi Jehovah ago ki tisiik ak ichek werikyik.

Keer anyun rumit ne o eng’ emait. Ruminito ko nyilen aeng’ rumit ne ming’in. Tos igeere bogisit ne mining’ ne mong’unee iyeto anan arusta? Bogisinito ko kaptisiisio ole beele tisiik tugun che ng’uu che onyiny che kiguure eng’ Bibilia nyamdutik. Mi kora kit ne tinyei taisiek tisab. Kit ne bo somok ne mi rumit ko meset ne kaginde magatinik 12 barak. Mitei karait ne nyitaat beek emait sang’ anan bii. Boisiee tisiik beechuto kounsee anan komwetisiee. Mitei kora kaptisiisio ne o ne kebeele tiong’ik koek kagochinet eng’ Jehovah. Emainito bo saet ko mi kwenut eng’ kambitab lagokab Israel.Komong’u 25:8-40; 26:1-37; 27:1-8; 28:1; 30:1-10, 17-21; 34:1, 2; Hebranik 9:1-5. Teebutik che Kineetengei

IGEERE logoek che tinyei bichu? Keer kit ne tee sabibuk, eechen ne tia, ma imuchi koib chito agenge! Keer kora logoek chon alak. Bunu ano logoechu kororon? Bunu emetab Kanan. Ibwati is ile emetab Kanan ko ole ki menyei Abraham, Isak ak Jakobo. Ki tun kobiit rubet eng’ emonoto, koyaach kouuto Jakobo lagokyik koba Misri. Nguno ko kogosiirto kenyisiek 216, ago indochin Musa lagokab Israel koweektagei Kanan. Kogoit ole kiguure Kades eng’ ong’atet.

Amu ki menyei bik che yaach emetab Kanan, koyookto Musa segeik 12 ak kolenji: ‘Oba ogeer kit ne tee bik che menyei emonoto ak ogeer ole kimen ne tia. Ogeer kora ole u nee mbarenik, ngot ko rurtos tuguk. Ye oweege oibu logoek tutigin.’

Kingoit kobunu Kanan, kolenji segeik aeng’u Musa: ‘Kararan iman emonoto,’ ak koboorji Musa logoekab emonoto. Nga u noto, ko kile segeik 10: ‘Eechen ago kimen bik che menyei oloto. Barech ngot ketiem keib emonoto.’

Ki arogenso anyun lagokab Israel kingo kas ng’alechoto ak komwa kole: ‘Ki ta kaigai kebegu eng’ Misri anan agot kemechi ong’atani. Ogeer anyun nguni, kibegu eng’ boriet ak kimuti kwonyikyok ak lagokyok. Ongelewen chito age ne ka ta Musa kondoiywech keweege Misri!’

Nga u noto, ko ki mi segeik aeng’u che ki imaang’u Jehovah che ki tiem kogaigai bik. Kainaikwak ko Josua ak Kaleb. Kolenji bik: ‘Mat oiywei kiy. Mi Jehovah kobotech ago nyumnyumitu koek nenyo emetab Kanan.’ Nga u noto, ko ma kas bik kot ko kimach agot kobar Josua ak Kaleb.

Ki yai nito konerech Jehovah ne bo kwong’ut ak kolenji Musa: ‘Ma mi chi ne bo kenyisiek 20 ak kwo tai ne imuchi kochut emetab Kanan. Ki kogeer kwong’utik che ki ayai eng’ Misri ak ong’atet ago ma iyano kora. Ko u noto, ayae koombeniot eng’ ong’atet kenyisiek 40 kot kome chito ne bo let. Chutei Josua ak Kaleb kityo emetab Kanan.’Koitosiek 13:1-33; 14:1-38. Teebutik che Kineetengei

TOS igeere mauwek ak logoek che kaing’atyo eng’ kirokto? Kirogito ko bo Aron. Kiing’atyo mauwechuto ak logoechuto eng’ kiroktab Aron eng’ kembout agenge kityo! Ngegeer anyun amu nee si koyaak ko u nito.

Kingo kagoombeniot Israelik kasarta ne koi eng’ ong’atet, konaam kobwat Kora, Datan, Abiram ak kandoik alak 250 kole ma nyolu koek Musa kandoindennywa ago ma nyolu koek Aron tisiindet ne o. Kibwa bichu tugul ak kolenji Musa: ‘Amu nee si ieetigei isiirech?’

Kilenji Musa Kora ak kasubikyik: ‘Omusu mutai karon, ak ingonde chi tugul nyamdutik che kibeelei kit ne kiibe mat, ak obwa emaitab Jehovah si kegeer kele ng’o ne leweni Jehovah.’

Ki yeit betut ne rubei, kobwa Kora, kasubikyik 250, ak bik alak che kiiyani ng’alekyik agoi emait ne kisaee. Ki nerech Jehovah ne bo kwong’ut. Kole anyun Musa: ‘Oistoege emaisiekab bichu amat otiiny kiy age tugul nenywa.’ Kogas it bik ak koistoegei emaisiekab Kora, Datan ak Abiram.

Kile Musa anyun: ‘Onaee nito ole ng’o ne kalewen Jehovah. Betaksei ng’onyut ak kolugui bichu yaach.’

Ki ye tar kong’alali Musa kityo, kobetak ng’onyut, ak kolugui emait ak tugukab Kora ak kolugui Datan, Abiram ak bik che ki mi tugul. Ki ye kas bik kowaaktos bichuto, kowaakyo ak ichek ak kole: ‘Ongemwei, imuch koluguech ng’onyut ak echek!’

Kasarata ko ki ta komi Kora ak kasubikyik 250 ole negite emaitab Jehovah. Koyook anyun Jehovah mat kobeel bichoto tugul. Kilenji Jehovah weritab Aron ne kiguuree Eleasar koib tuguk che kibeelen nyamdutik che bo bik che kagobek ak kotany kolebelitu si ketuge kaptisisiet. Ki yai ko u nito si kobiit kobwatyi ichek kole ma magat koek chito age tisiindet kobaate Aron ak werikyik.

Amu ki machei Jehovah koboor komie kole kigolewen Aron ak werikyik koek tisiik, kolenji Musa: ‘Ilenji kandoin ne bo bororiet age tugul eng’ Israel koib kiroktanyi. Eng’ bororietab Lawi koib Aron kiroktanyi. Ye ibata inde kirokwechuto taitab moingetab kayonjinet eng’ emaitab saet orit. Ing’atos mauwek eng’ kiroktab chito ne kalewen koek tisiindet.’

Kingoit subui betut ne rubei, kogeer Musa kotinyei kiroktab Aron mauwechu igeere eng’ pichait ak logoek che ruriotin che kiguuree almond. Ara anyun, kaigeer amu ne si koyai Jehovah kong’atyo mauwek eng’ kiroktab Aron?Koitosiek 16:1-49; 17:1-11; 26:10. Teebutik che Kineetengei

KI SIIRTO kenyisiek 39 ko ta komitei Israelik ong’atet! Eng’ kenyisiechu tugul ko kirib Jehovah ichek. Ki bae mana, koboisie toloitab boldet kondochi icheget bet ak toloitab mat kokweng’kyi ichek kemoi. Eng’ kenyisiechoto tugul, ko ma meeiyo ngoroikwak ago ma ibwonso kelyekwak.

Ni ko arawet ne tai kenyitab 40 kong’eete ngomong’ lagokab Israel eng’ Misri. Kobir kambi kogeny Israelik eng’ Kades. Yuto ko ole ki iyoktoe Musa segeik 12 koba kosegei emetab Kanan kenyisiek 40 che kigosiirto. Yuto kora ole kimeen tupchetab Musa ne keguuren Miriam. Ago ko u eng’ tai, ko mi kaimutik yuto kora.

Ma nyor bik beek eng’ yuto. Ko u noto, konaam kong’unyng’unyso ak kolenji Musa: ‘Ki ta kaigai kebegu eng’ Misri. Kilya si imutwech eng’ Misri agoi oli ole marurtos tuguk? Ma mi bandek, ma mi sabibuk ago ma mi logoek alak tugul. Ma mi agot beek che kiee!’

Kingoba Musa ak Aron emait ne kisaee kolenji Jehovah: ‘Iyum bik tugul ak eng’ tainnywa tugul ing’alalji koin. Mong’u beek che yamei bik ak kiyagik tugul.’

Koyum anyun Musa bik ak kolenji: ‘Ogas okwek che motinye kayanet eng’ Jehovah! Tos kimoong’wok beek ane ak Aron eng’ ruandani?’ Kokweree kiroktanyi anyun Musa koita konyil aeng’, korongee beek che chang’ ne bo kwong’ut. Kibiit beek anyun che yamei koe bik ak kiyagik tugul.

Nga u noto, ko ki nerekyi Jehovah Musa ak Aron. Tos ingen amu nee? Amu kile Musa ak Aron icheget che kiimoong’u beek eng’ koita, ago eng’ iman ko ki Jehovah ne kiyae komong’ beek eng’ koita. Amu ma mwa imanit Musa ak Aron agobo nito, kole Jehovah kerekong’ icheget. Kolenji: ‘Momuti bikyuk agoi emetab Kanan.’

Ma tianit komanda Israelik eng’ Kades. Kiit anyun Tulwet ne kiguure Hor. Kimechi tulwonito barak Aron kobo kenyisiek 123. Koimngei Israelik ne bo kwong’ut ak korirji Aron betusiek 30. Kiek anyun Eleasar weritab Aron tisiindet ne o ne bo bororietab Israel.Koitosiek 20:1-13, 22-29; Ne Kibwate Ng’atutik 29:5. Teebutik che Kineetengei

KEER erenani mi ketit barak, tos toogu ko u yo sobei? Ma sobei. Nito ko ndaret ne ki kichobee karnet ne kuree Bibilia sugunwet. Kilenji Jehovah Musa konde erenanito ketit barak si komuch kogeer bik ak kosobcho. Nga u noto, kosobtos ndarok alak che igeere ko mitei ng’ony. Kogosus bik ago miandos bik nguno. Tos ingen amu nee?

Kiing’unyng’unyji Jehovah ak Musa lagokab Israel, noto amu nee si kosusei ndarochuto. Kiing’unyng’unyso kole: ‘Kilya si omoong’wech eng’ Misri nyo kebegu eng’ ong’atani? Mami amitwogik ama mi beek yuto, ago ma kemoche ko ta keam mana kogeny.’

Nga u noto, mana ko amitwogik che kororon. Kiigochi Jehovah lagokab Israel mana eng’ oretab kwong’utiet, ago ki yai kwong’utiet kora kogochi beek. Nga u noto, ko ki ma kotinyei bik kongoi agobo ole kigoribto Jehovah. Kiiyook Jehovah anyun erenok si koek kergong’iet eng’ lagokab Israel. Ki sus erenochoto bik, ago ki beg bik che chang’ kosubgei ak nito.

Kiit anyun kobwonji bik Musa ak kolenji: ‘Kogeyai tengek amu koging’alal koya agobo Jehovah ak inye. Kaigai saiywech ilenji Jehovah koisto ndarochu.’ Ki sachi Musa anyun bik. Kolenji Jehovah kochob erenetab sugunwet. Kilenji konde erenanoto ketit barak, ago ki nyolu konyal chi tugul ne kasus ndaret erenanoto bo sugunwet. Ki yai Musa ko u ye kigamwachi Jehovah, ago ki ye inyal bik che kigasus ndarok erenanoto bo sugunwet, kosobcho.

Toretech nito kinetgei kiy. Kigergei achek tugul ak Israelichoto ki sus ndarok, amu ma mi chi ne ma meei. Igeere bik koyoosegitu, komiandos ak kobegu. Amu nee? Amu kiingelelji Jehovah bik che tai Adam ak Awa ago ki lagokwak. Nga u noto, ko kigochobwech Jehovah oret si kimuch kemeng’isien koigeny.

Kiiyook Jehovah Werinnyi Jesu Kristo konyo ng’ony. Ki kigartat Jesu eng’ ketit amu kiibwatyin bik che chang’ kole ki chi ne ya. Nga u noto, ko kiiyook Jehovah Jesu si kobiit kosorwech. Ngot kisub Jesu, kimuchi kenyoru sobondab koigeny. Nga u noto, ko ta kinetigei agobo nito eng’ atindonik che mi tai.Koitosiek 21:4-9; Johana 3:14, 15. Teebutik che Kineetengei

KIIGASE kong’alali sigiriet? Imuch ile ‘Achicha, ma ng’alaldos tiong’ik.’ Nga u noto, komwae Bibilia agobo sigiriet ne ki ng’alal. Ngegeer kit ne kiyaak.

Negit kochobok Israelik kochut emetab Kanan. Ago mitei laitoriat ne bo Moab ne keguure Balak ne arogeni agobo lagokab Israel. Ko u noto, koyookto chito ne ng’om ne kiguure Balaam kwo kochub Israelik. Kilenji Balak Balaam ngot kwo, kogochin robisiek che chang’. Ki nam banda anyun Balaam eng’ sigiriennyi kwo konyor Balak.

Ma machei Jehovah kochub Balaam bikyik. Ko u noto, koyookto malaikaiyat ne tinyei rotwab chok kotonon eng’ oret si koteer Balaam. Mageerei Balaam malaikaiyat nga u noto ko keerei sigiriennyin. Ki tiem koistoengei sigiriet malaikaiyat, ago ki eng’ let koru kityo eng’ oret. Konerech ne bo kwong’ut Balaam ak kobiree kirokto sigiriennyin.

Ko yai anyun Jehovah kong’alalji sigiriet Balaam. Koteeb sigiriet kole: ‘Kayaun nee si ibiro?’

Kolenji Balaam: ‘Amu keyaa aberberit, ago ndo kotinye rotwet ko katabarin!’

Kotebee sigiriet kole: ‘Tos kiayaun ko u nito betut age?’

Kowol Balaam kole: ‘Achicha.’

Ki yat anyun Jehovah konyekab Balaam kogeer malaikaiyat ne ki tinyei rotwet ak ko tononi eng’ oret. Kole malaikaiyat: ‘Kalya si ibir sigirieng’ung’? Kanyo ateerin amu ma nyolu iwe ichub Israel. Ndo ma istoenage sigirieng’ung’, ko ka ta barin ago ka ma ta tiinye sigirieng’ung’.’

Kole Balaam: ‘Kaayai tengek. Ma anai ale ketononi eng’ oret.’ Koyanji anyun malaikaiyat Balaam kwo, ago kitestai Balaam kwo konyor Balak. Ki tiem kora kochub Israel, nga u noto ko ki yai Jehovah koberur Israel konyil somok.Koitosiek 21:21-35; 22:1-40; 23:1-30; 24:1-25. Teebutik che Kineetengei

MACHEI Musa kochut emetab Kanan koboto Israelik. Koteeb kole: ‘Jehovah, iyanwo alandae Ainetab Jordan awo ageer emet ne kararan.’ Kowolji Jehovah kolenji: ‘Ngoyam! Mata ta imwa ng’alechon kogeny!’ Tos ingen amu nee si kowolji Jehovah ko u noto?

Amu kit ne ki kayaak kingo kwerei Musa ruandet. Ibwat ile ki ma teegis Musa ak Aron Jehovah kasarata. Ma mwachi bik kolenji ki Jehovah ne ki konu beek kobun ruandet. Nito amu nee si kole Jehovah ma iyanjin Musa ak Aron kochut Kanan.

Ko u noto, kingo siirto arawek tutigin kong’eete ngome Aron, kolenji Jehovah Musa: ‘Imut Josua ak itonon eng’ taitab Eleasar tisiindet ak eng’ taitab bik tugul. Ak eng’ tainnywa tugul, imwachi ilenji kong’eete nguni, ko egu Josua kandoinennywa.’ Ki yai Musa ko u noto ko u ye igeere eng’ pichaini.

Kolenji Jehovah Josua anyun: ‘Kimitu amat iywei. Indochini lagokab Israel agoi emetab Kanan ne kiamwachi alenji agochini, ago ami koboten.’

Ki ye ibata, kolenji Jehovah Musa kolaany Tulwetab Nebo agoi barak, tulwet ne mi emetab Moab. Kingomi yoto Musa, kogeer emet ne kararan ne bo Kanan ne ki mi bitetab Ainetab Jordan. Kolenji anyun Jehovah: ‘Nito emet ne kigamwa ale agochini lagokab Abraham, Isak ak Jakobo. Kachamun igeer, nga u noto ko machamun ichut emonito.’

Kimechi Tulwonoto bo Nebo barak Musa ko bo kenyisiek 120. Ki ta ko kim ago ki ta kogeerei komie konyekyik. Koimngei ak koriryo bik mising’ agobo meetab Musa. Nga u noto, ko kinyor kagaigaet amu kiingen kole mi kandoindet age, Josua.Koitosiek 27:12-23; Ne Kibwate Ng’atutik 3:23-29; 31:1-8, 14-23; 32:45-52; 34:1-12. Teebutik che Kineetengei

YAACH ng’alek eng’ murenichu. Ngot ko ma mweiso, kebarei. Murenichuto ko segeik che bunu Israel, ko kwonyi toreti, keguure Rahab. Menyei Rahab yuto, got ne mi inatutab Jeriko. Ngegeer amu nee si ko mi mat bichu.

Chobotin Israelik kolandae Ainetab Jordan si kochut emetab Kanan. Ko tomo koba, koyookto Josua segeik aeng’ ak kolenji: ‘Oba ogeer emet ak ogeer nganasetab Jeriko.’ Ki yeit segeik Jeriko, koba gotab Rahab. Nga u noto, ko mi chito ne kimwachi laitoriatab Jeriko kolenji: ‘Mi Israelik aeng’u rani che kabwa kosegei emet.’ Kingogas nito laitoriat, koyookto murenik koba kolenji Rahab: ‘Imoong’u murenik che mi gong’ung’!’ Nga u noto, ko kiga kouny Rahab segeichoto eng’ got barak. Kolenji Rahab murenichoto: ‘Kabwa iman murenik gonnyu, nga u noto ko mongen ole kabunu. Kamanda konegit koimen, kotomo keger kurgotikab nganaset. Ngot ochakte, omuchi onam!’ Koba anyun murenichoto koon.

Kingo kagoba, kochakta Rahab kwo got barak ak kolenji segeichoto: ‘Angen ale konok Jehovah emoni. Ki kegas agobo ole kiiyaamda Jehovah Nyanjet ne Birir ye ki omong’u eng’ Misri ak ole ki obarte laitorinik che kiguure Sihon ak Og. Ara anyun amu kaayaiywok ne mie, oyosieiywo anan omurte ole oyaiywo ne mie ak okwek. Osaru babanyu ak kamennyu ak che kitupche tugul.’

Kiiyasiechi segeichoto Rahab kole yaei ko u noto, nga u noto, ko mi kit ne ki magat koyai Rahab. Kilenji segeik Rahab: ‘Ratyi rogoet anan borowet ne birir tirisieng’ung’ ak iyum tilyonutiguk tugul eng’ gong’ung’, si ye kiweege keng’em Jeriko, ko ye kigeer rogoani eng’ tirisieng’ug’ ko ma kibarei chi age tugul ne mi gong’ung’.’ Kingoweektagei segeik ole mi Josua, komwachi kiy age tugul ne kiyaak.Josua 2:1-24; Hebranik 11:31. Teebutik che Kineetengei

KEER O! Bunei Israelik Ainetab Jordan. Amu nee si ma mi beek ainet? Eng’ kasarito bo kenyit ko o robta ne bo kwong’ut ago nyolu konyitaat beek ainet. Nga u noto, ko ma ko mi beek ago bunei Israelik emet ne yaamat ko u ye ki bunei Nyanjet ne Birir! Mi ano beek? Ngegeer.

Kingo machei Israelik kobun Ainetab Jordan, komwachi Jehovah Josua kolenji bik: ‘Nyolu koib tisiik moingetab kayonjinet ak kondo. Ye tiech kityo kelyekab tisiik Ainetab Jordan, ko tononso beek ma ko rotei.’

Kiib anyun tisiik moingetab kayonjinet ak kondoe bik. Ki ye it tisiik Ainetab Jordan kotiech beek. Nganda ki rwae beek mising’ ko ki ye tiiny kelyekwak beek, kotononso beek. Kiek kwong’utiet amu ki iyumgei beek eng’ komosta agenge ne bo ainet. Ne ma tianit ko ma ko mi beek che rootei! Ki ba anyun tisiichu kiibei moingetab kayonjinet agoi kwenutab ainet ne yamaat. Tos igeere icheget eng’ pichaini? Ki tononso tisiik eng’ kwenutab ainet ak kobun Israelik tugul Ainetab Jordan! Kingo ka kobun bik tugul ainet, kolenji Jehovah Josua komwachi murenik 12 che kimen kole: ‘Oba agoi ainet ole tonone tisiik che ibei moingetab kayonjinet, ak okwei koik 12 ak obe opangan eng’ ole oruiytosi kemouni. Tun ye teebenak lagokwok kole ibooru nee koichu, olenji ibwotwech kole ki tononso beek ki ngobun moingetab kayonjinet Ainetab Jordan.’ Ki pangan Josua kora koik 12 eng’ ole kiga tonone tisiik eng’ ainet orit.

Kilenji anyun Josua tisiik che ki ibei moinget: ‘Omong’u eng’ Ainet.’ Ki ngomong’ eng’ ainet tisiik, konaam koroot beek kogeny.Josua 3:1-17; 4:1-18. Teebutik che Kineetengei

NEE ne kayai inatusiechu bo Jeriko kolulyo? U yo kagiwiree bomit. Nga u noto, ko ki ma komi bomisiek betusiechoto, agot bundugisiek ko ki ma komi. Nito ko kwong’utiet age ne bo Jehovah. Ngegeer amu nee si koyaak ko u nito.

Kilenji Jehovah Josua: ‘Magat obe ak mureniguk che bo boriet ak omuut nganaset konyil agenge kila betut. Oyai ko u noto betusiek lo. Magat otinye moingetab kayonjinet ak ngondoe tisiik moingonoto koguutei igondisiekwak.

‘Eng’ betutab tisab ko magat omuut nganaset konyil tisab ak oguut igondisiek ak kowaach chi tugul wagatab boriet. Ye oyai ko u noto koluldos inatusiek tugul!’



Ki yai anyun Josua ak bik kit age tugul ne ki kamwachi Jehovah. Ki ma komi chi ne twegu kingo tesetai komuutei nganaset. Kit ne ki kigasei kityo ko ki igondisiek ak kelyekab bik. Lasima ki arogenso ne bo kwong’ut bunikab bikab Jehovah eng’ Jeriko. Tos igeere got ne isonginini borowet ne birir eng’ tirisia? Bo Rahab goito. Ki yai kit ne ki kamwachi segeik aeng’u ago mi inendet ak bikab gonnyi tugul kogeerei kit age tugul ne tesetai.

Kingoit betutab tisab, komuut bik nganaset konyil tisab koguutei igondisiek, kowaakyo murenikab boriet ak kolulyo anyun inatusiekab Jeriko. Kilenji Josua bikyik: ‘Obar chi tugul eng’ nganaset ak obel. Obel kit age tugul ak omete feda, tahabu ak tugukab karnok si ogoite kegonor eng’ emaitab Jehovah.’

Kolenji anyun Josua segeik aeng’: ‘Oba gotab Rahab ak omutu inendet ak gonnyi tugul.’ Ko u ole ki kamwaita segeik, ko kigisor anyun Rahab ak bikab gonnyi tugul.Josua 6:1-25. Teebutik che Kineetengei

KEER tuguchu balchin ng’ony chichi eng’ emainnyi orit! Tuguchuto ko ngoriet ne kararan, tahabu ak fedaisiek. Kaibu tuguchuto eng’ Jeriko. Tos ta ibwati ile ki nyolu keita nee tugukab Jeriko?

Ki magat kigoito tahabu ak fedaisiek koba emaitab Jehovah ne kisaee, ko tuguk alak tugul ko ki magat keng’em. Kiingelelji Jehovah bichu amu ki chor tuguk che ki nyolu kobunji Kamuktaindet. Kiguure chichi Akan ko chu alak ko bigab gonnyi. Ngegeer kit ne yaaksei.

Kingobata lugetab Jeriko ole kigachoree Akan tuguk, koyookto Josua kora murenik koba luget eng’ nganaset ne kiguure Ai. Nga u noto, ko kigisindan, ki kibar alak, komweiso alage. Koimgei Josua ne bo kwong’ut. Kiing’uruk ak kosa kolenji Jehovah: ‘Amu nee si iyan koyaak tuguchu?’

Kowol Jehovah kole: ‘Ng’eet! Kogoyai tengek Israel. Kogoib tuguk che ko magat keng’em ak che ko magat kigoito koba emait ne kisaee. Kochor ngoriet ne kararan ak kouny. Maberurok ngot ko mong’em tuguchoto ak chito ne kochorei.’ Kile Jehovah anyun toreti Josua konai kole ng’o chichoto ya.

Kingoyum Josua bik tugul, koboor Jehovah kole ki Akan chorindet. Kole Akan: ‘Kaayai tengek. Koageer ngoriet ne kararan, tahabu ak fedaisiek ak amakyigei mising’ kot aib. Onyorjini emainnyu orit, koabalji ng’ony.’

Ki ye kinyor tuguchoto, keibchi Josua. Kolenji Josua Akan: ‘Amu nee si iibwech kaimutik? Ibun Jehovah kaimutik aginye amu koiibwech kaimutik!’ Ki nam bik koik anyun ak kolach Akan ak bikab gonnyi kot kobeg. Tos ma ibooru nito kole ma nyolu keib kiy age tugul ne bo chi ole kigoi?

Ki ye ibata, koba Israelik koborio ak bikab Ai kogeny. Kotoret Jehovah anyun bikyik kasarito kosindonis.Josua 7:1-26; 8:1-29. Teebutik che Kineetengei

CHOBOTIN bikab Kanan koborio ak lagokab Israel, ibwati kole imuchi kosindanis. Nga u noto, ko ma ibwati ko u noto bik che menyei nganaset ne kiguure Gibeon. Ingen ichek kole toreti Kamuktaindet Israelik, ago ma machei koborio ak Jehovah. Ara anyun, tos ingen ile ki yai nee bikab Gibeon?

Kingo machei koba konyor Josua bikab Gibeon, koyaigei ko u yo menyei ole loo ne bo kwong’ut. Kiilach ngoroik che kigogereris ak kweonik anan kwosiek che ki koosegitu. Kiib kora kuniok che oosen eng’ sigiroikwak ak magatinik che kiga koyaamnyo. Ki ba anyun konyor Josua ak kolenji: ‘Kibunu ole loo ne bo kwong’ut amu kogegas agobo Kamuktaindeng’wong’ Jehovah. Kigegas kit ne ki yaiywok kingo ta omi emetab Misri. Kolenjech anyun boisiekyok kechob amitwogik ak kebwa agoi ole omi ak kemwowok kele: “Ki otwogiguk, ara anyun, ongeyai arorutiet ak okwek, omwaiwech ole moyae boriet ak achek.” Ogeer agot ole kogogereris ngoroikyok ago kogoyaamnyo magatinikyok amu loo ole kebunu.’

Kiiyan Josua ak kandoik alak ng’alekab bikab Gibeon. Ko u noto, komwachi kole ma yachin boriet ichek. Nga u noto, ko kingo siirto betusiek somogu, konai kole kagaa ki menyei ole negit bikab Gibeon.

Kotebee Josua kolenji: ‘Amu nee si omwowech ole obunu emet ne loo?’

Kowolji bikab Gibeon kole: ‘Kogiyai ko u noto amu ki kimwawech kele kile Kamuktaindeng’wong’ Jehovah konok emoni bo Kanan tugul. Ki kiywei anyun kele tos obarech.’ Ki yai anyun Israelik ko u ye kigamwa, ma bar bikab Gibeon, kiyai koek otwogikwak.

Ki nerech laitoriatab Jerusalem amu ki yai kalyet bikab Gibeon ak Israelik. Komwachi anyun laitorinik alak ang’wan kole: ‘Obwa otoreton keborie emetab Gibeon.’ Kiituiyogei laitorinichoto ang’wanu ak laitoriatab Jerusalem koyai ko u noto. Amu kiit komach laitorinik mutu kobar bikab Gibeon, ko tos kimwa kele kiboisiee ng’omnatet iman bikab Gibeon koyai kalyet ak Israelik? Ta kegeere.Josua 9:1-27; 10:1-5. Teebutik che Kineetengei

TOS igeere kit ne yae Josua? Lenjin asista: ‘Asisi, tonon!’ Ki yai Jehovah kotonon asista betut komugul. Ngegeer amu nee si komach Josua kotonon asista.

Ki ye inaam laitorinik mutu che yaach eng’ emetab Kanan koborio ak bikab Gibeon, koyookto bikab Gibeon chito kwo kosom Josua toretet. Kilenji Josua: ‘Chogu nyo soruech! Kogobwa laitorinik tugul che bo emet koborio ak otwogiguk.’

Ki ba Josua ak bikyik che bo boriet sainoto. Ki ba kemboi komugul. Ki ye it Gibeon, koarogenso bikab luget che bo laitorinik mut ak konaam komweiso. Ki yai anyun Jehovah kowirgei koik che eechen eng’ kipsengwet, ago kichang’a bik che kibeg eng’ koichoto kosiir che ki bar bikab Josua che bo boriet.

Kingo keer Josua kole ki negit kororokto asista, konai kole imuchi kochililso bikab luget che bo laitorinik mut. Noto amu nee si kosa Josua kole: ‘Asisi, tonon!’ Ki ye testai anyun kolal asista, konyor Israelik kasarta ne bo kosindan bunikwak.

Ki ta ko mi laitorinik che chang’ che yaach emetab Kanan che sasei bikab Jehovah. Ki beg kenyisiek lou si kosindan Josua ak lugennyi laitorinik 31 che bo emonoto. Ki ye ibata noto, kopchechi Josua mbarenik bororiosiek tugul che ki tomo konyor mbaret.

Ki eng’ let ko kagobata kenyisiek che chang’, kome Josua ko bo kenyisiek 110. Ki testai kogas it Jehovah bik kingo ta kosobtos Josua ak choronokyik. Nga u noto, ko kingo beg bichuto miachen, konaam bik koyai tuguk che yaach ago kiigochi nito kaimutik. Ki kasarta nito ne ki magat konyor toretetab Jehovah.Josua 10:6-15; 12:7-24; 14:1-5; Kiruogik 2:8-13. Teebutik che Kineetengei

KINGO nyor Israelik kaimutik, korirji Jehovah. Ki kasyi Jehovah sautikwak ak kogochi kandoik che nyigonen. Kuure Bibilia kandoichuto kiruogik. Kiruogindet ne tai ko ki Josua, ko alak ko ki Otniel, Ehud ak Samgar. Nga u noto, ko mi kwonyik aeng’u che ki nyigonen che ki toret Israel, kiguure kwonyichoto Debora ak Jael. Ki maotiot Debora. Ki igochin Jehovah logoiywek agobo kasarta ne nyonei si komwachi bik. Ki kiruogindet kora inendet. Ki cham kotebee ketit kel ago ki bwanei bik komwochin kaimutikwak si konyor toretet.

Kasarito ko ki laitoriatab Kanan Jabin ago ki tinyei karisiekab boriet 900. Ki kimen bikab lugennyi kot ko kiilasimishan Israelik alak koek kiboitinikab Jabin. Chito ne kiindochin bikab luget che bo Laitoriat Jabin, ko ki kiguure Sisera.

Kiiyokto Debora chito betut agenge koguur Barak, ak kolenji: ‘Kamwa Jehovah kole: “Imut murenik 10,000 koba Tulwetab Tabor, si amutun Sisera ak ande inendet ak bikyik che bo boriet euneguk.”’

Kolenji Barak Debora: ‘Awendi ngot kebendi tuwai.’ Kiiyan anyun Debora koba tuwai, nga u noto kolenji Barak: ‘Ma bunjinin teegisto amu aldochin Jehovah Sisera eunekab kwondo.’ Ago kiyaak iman ko u noto.

Ki chortagei Barak eng’ Tulwetab Tabor kwo kotuiyo ak bikab luget che bo Sisera. Koyai Jehovah komaran emet ago kibar beek bikab luget che chang’. Nga u noto, ko kireg Sisera eng’ karinnyi ne bo luget ak komwei.

Kingosiirto kasarta, koit Sisera emaitab Jael. Kotaach Jael inendet ak kogochi chego kolu. Ki yai nito anyun kobirto met ak koru. Konam Jael ketit ne ng’atib ne kinamee emait ak kobirji metitab chichoto ya. Kingonyo Barak, koboorji Jael bortab Sisera! Ara anyun, ka igeer ile kiyaak kit ne ki kamwa Debora.

Ki kibar anyun Laitoriat Jabin kora, ago kinyor Israelik kalyet kogeny.Kiruogik 2:14-22; 4:1-24; 5:1-31. Teebutik che Kineetengei

MI BUKUIT ne keguuren Ruth eng’ Bibilia. Ng’alalee bukuinito agobo gabchi ne ki mi kasarta ki ta komi kiruogik Israel. Ruth ko kwondo ne bunu emetab Moab, ma bo bororietab Israel inendet, bororiet ne kigalewen Jehovah. Nga u noto, ko kingonetgei Ruth agobo Kamuktaindet ne bo iman Jehovah, kocham ne bo kwong’ut. Naomi ko chepyoso ne kiga koeet, ago inendet ne ki toreti Ruth konetgei agobo Jehovah.

Naomi ko bo Israel. Mi kasarta ne ki ng’ering’ amitwogik eng’ Israel, koyaach ko ba Naomi ak manong’otiondennyi koboto werikwak aeng’ emetab Moab. Kingo ta komi emonoto bo Moab, kome manong’otiotab Naomi. Kiitun werikyik tibik aeng’ che bo Moab che kiguure Ruth ak Orpa. Nga u noto, ko kingobata kenyisiek 10, kobeg werikab Naomi. Kigas ng’wanindo Naomi ak kwonyikab werichoto ne tia! Ara si ko yai nee Naomi nguno?

Kiit betut agenge ne kimach Naomi koweek olinywa ole mi bikyik. Amu ki ma komachei Ruth ak Orpa kobesio ak Naomi, koba tugul. Nga u noto, ko kingo kagoba kitigin, koweekyigei Naomi Orpa ak Ruth ak kolenji: ‘Ngoweek chi tugul olinywa ole mi kamennyi.’

Ki toroch Naomi kwonyichoto ak kolenji saisere. Konaam koriryo kwonyichuto amu ki chamei Naomi ne bo kwong’ut. Komwa kole: ‘Achicha! Kibendi tugul ole mi bikwok.’ Kowolji Naomi kolenji: ‘Magat oweege oling’wong’ tibikyuk. Kararan eng’ okwek ye omi gaa.’ Kiinaam anyun Orpa koweektagei, nga u noto ko ma wo Ruth.

Kilenji Naomi Ruth: ‘Ka kwo Orpa gaa, wui ak inye.’ Kowolji Ruth kole: ‘Metiem ilenjo abagachin! Chamwo kebe tuwai. Ole iweendi aweendi, ak ole itebee atebee ak ane. Egu biguk bikyuk, ak egu Kamuktaindeng’ung’ Kamuktaindennyu. Ole imechini amechini ak ane ak ketupcho yoto.’ Kingomwa ko u nito Ruth, ko ma ta kotiem Naomi kolenji koweektagei olinywa.

Ki eng’ let koit kwonyichuto Israel ak komeng’is eng’ oloto. Ki toi Ruth kobois eng’ mbarenik amu ki kasarta ne ki kigesei nganuk. Kiiyanji chito ne kiguure Boas koyum nganuk eng’ mbarennyi. Tos ingen ile ki ng’o kametab Boas? Ki Rahab ne bo nganasetab Jeriko.

Mi betut ne kilenji Boas Ruth: ‘Koagas agobo inye, ak mieindo ne kiiboorji Naomi. Angen ale kiibagach kwandang’ung’ ak kameng’ung’ ak emeng’ung’ ak inyo imeng’isie ak bik che ki ma ingen. Ingoyaun Jehovah che miach!’

Kowol Ruth kole: ‘Kaiyaiwo ne mie kiptaiyandenyu. Kaigaigaa amu keng’alalwon eng’ oret ne mie.’ Kocham anyun Boas Ruth ne bo kwong’ut, ago ma siirto kasarta ne tia kotungei. Ki boibochi Naomi ne bo kwong’ut! Ki baibait agot mising’ kingo sich Ruth ak Boas werinnywa ne tai ne kiguure Obed. Ki tun kosich Obed kwandab Daudi. Ta kinetigei che chang’ agobo Daudi eng’ atindonik che mi tai.Bukuitab Ruth 1-4. Teebutik che Kineetengei

IGEERE kit ne yaaksei eng’ yu? Bichu tugul ko bikab boriet che bo Israel. Chu igeere kong’uruktos, ko ee beek. Ko ni tononi eng’ ole ee beek bichuto ko kiruogindet ne kiguure Gideon. Keerei ole eeitoi beek bichuto.

Keer komie ile teer ole eeitoi beek bichu. Mi che ing’urukyin. Nga u noto, ko mi agenge ne een eunnyi si kobiit kogeer kit ne imuch koyaak eng’ ole negite. Ki bo kamanut koyai ko u noto amu kigalenji Jehovah Gideon kolewen kityo bik che ee beek ak kogeerei kit ne tesetai, ko bik che ma yae ko u noto, ko nyolu koba gaa. Ngegeer amu nee.

Kiit kasarta ne kiiumisani bikab Midian Israelik amu ki kago kimegitu kosiir ichek. Kiyaak ko u noto amu ma kas it Israelik Jehovah. Ko u noto, kosom Israelik Jehovah torotet, ago kigas inendet rirekwak.

Kolenji Jehovah Gideon kocheng’ bikab luget. Ki cheng’ anyun Gideon murenik 32,000 che bo boriet. Nga u noto, ko kimi Midianik 135,000 che ki chobotin koyai boriet ak bikab Israel. Kolenji Jehovah Gideon: ‘Chang murenichu itinye.’ Ki amu nee si ko mwa Jehovah ko u noto?

Amu ndo kiga sindonis Israelik eng’ luget kotinyei askarik 32,000, ko kita ibwati kole ki sindonis eng’ kimnatenywa, ma eng’ toretetab Jehovah. Ko u noto, kolenji Jehovah Gideon: ‘Ilenji murenik che nyogoren koweektagei gaa.’ Komwachi Gideon bik ko u noto, koweetagei murenik 22,000 gaa. Kong’et anyun murenik 10,000 kityo che nyolu koyai boriet ak bikab luget 135,000 che bo Midian.

Nga u noto, kole Jehovah: ‘Ta ko chang’ murenichu itinye.’ Ko u noto kolenji Gideon murenik koe beek eng’ ainoni ko u ye igeere eng’ pichait ago bik che ing’urukyin beek, koweektagei gaa. Kolenji Jehovah Gideon: ‘Isindonisiei inye ak murenik 300 che ma ing’urukyi beek.’ Kiit anyun kasarta ne bo luget. Kopchei Gideon murenik 300 konyil somok ak kogochi chi tugul igondit anan iryombu ak teret ne kaginde mat orit. Kingo negit koit kemoi kwen, kosungugan tugul ole kiga biree kambi bunik. Eng’ kasarata kora, koguut tugul igondisiekwak ak kotui terenikwak ak kowaakyo kole: ‘Rotwetab chok ne bo Jehovah ak ne bo Gideon!’ Kingo ng’eetyo bikab luget che bo Midian, koarogenso ne bo kwong’ut. Kiinaam komweiso bichoto ago kisindonis bikab Israel.Kiruogik kurgetab 6 agoi 8. Teebutik che Kineetengei

data.titulo: Ng’olyot ne ki Le Jepta Yae
data.contenido:
TOS kiimwa besio ile iyae kiy ak kouit iyai? Ki yai ko u noto chichi igeere eng’ pichaini ago noto amu nee si koimegei mising’. Chichi ko kiruogindet ne nyigan ne bo Israel ne kiguuree Jepta.

Ki mi Jepta kasarta ne ki ma ta koboisiechin Israelik Jehovah. Ki yaei Israelik kogeny tuguk che yaach. Ko u noto, kometo Jehovah konyalil Amonik Israelik. Ki yai nito korirji Israelik Jehovah kole: ‘Kigeyaun tengek. Kaigai soruech!’

Kiimjigei bik tuguk che yaach che kiga koyai. Noto amu nee si konaam koboisiechi Jehovah kogeny. Ki toret anyun Jehovah icheget.

Kigilewen Jepta kondochi bikab boriet koba boriet emetab Amonik. Ki machei mising’ Jepta toretetab Jehovah eng’ borionoto. Ko u noto kolenji Jepta Jehovah: ‘Ngot itoreton asindan bikab Amon, ko chito ne tai ne kamong’ eng’ gonnyu kotorokwo, agonin.’ Kigas anyun Jehovah ng’olyot ne ki mwa Jepta, noto amu nee si ki toret inendet kosindonis eng’ boriet. Tos ingen ile ng’o ne kimong’ konyo kotoroch Jepta kingoweek eng’ boriet? Ibwat o, ki cheptanyi ago ki lakwennyi ne inegei. Korir Jepta kole: ‘Bwo cheptanyu! Kaigono aimgei ne tia! Kaamwachi ng’olyon Jehovah, ago ma awale ng’olyondonoto.’

Kingonai cheptab Jepta agobo ng’olyot ne kigamwachi babanyi Jehovah, koimgei agine amu ki yachei kobagach kwandanyi ak choronokyik ak kwo kotebee hekalutab Jehovah ne ki mi Silo eng’ sobennyi tugul. Ko u noto kolenji babanyi: ‘Ngot ko koimwachi Jehovah ng’olyon, ko nyolu iyai ko u noto.’

Ki wo anyun cheptab Jepta Silo, ago ki tebi eng’ hekalutab Jehovah sobennyi tugul koboisiechin Jehovah. Betusiek ang’wan eng’ kenyit age tugul, ko ki bendi kwonyikab Israel kogati ago nito ko ki kasarta ne bo boiboiyet eng’ ichek tugul. Kigichamei cheptab Jepta ne bo kwong’ut amu ki chamei Jehovah.Kiruogik 10:6-18; 11:1-40. Teebutik che Kineetengei

TOS kiigase agobo chito ne ki kim kosiir tugul, ago tos ingen kainennyi? Chichoto ko kiruogindet ne ki kiguure Samson. Jehovah ne kiigochin Samson kimnatet. Kingo tomo kesich Samson, kolenji Jehovah kamennyi: ‘Isiche werit konegit ago ta tun kosoru Israelik eng’ eunekab Pilistik.’

Pilistik ko bik che yaach che menyei Kanan. Tinyei bikab luget che chang’ ak koiimi Israelik. Mi betut agenge ne ki wendi Samson ole menyei Pilistik, kotuiyo ak ng’etundo, kobar ng’etunyoto eng’ eunekyik. Ki bar kora Samson Pilistik che chang’.

Kiit kasarta ne ki chamnyo Samson ak kwondo ne ki kiguure Delila. Ko amu ki machei kandoikab Pilistik konai kit ne yae Samson kogimit, kolenji Delila igochin kandoindet age tugul ne bo Pilistik fedaisiek 1,100 ngot komwachi kit ne yae Samson kogimit. Ki machei Delila robisiechoto tugul. Kiiyan anyun amu ki ma ko choruet ne bo iman ne bo Samson ak bikab Jehovah. Kong’etee betunoto, konaam koteebee Samson ole bunu kimnatennyi.



Ki eng’ let komwachi Samson Delila agobo ole bunu kimnatennyi. Kilenji: ‘Tomo ketilwo sumekyuk ole kigoi! Ki leweno Jehovah aek kiboitiondennyi ne inegei ne kiguure Nasiritindet kong’etee ngesichon. Ngot ketil sumekyuk, kobegu kimnatennyu.’

Kingo nai anyun Delila agobo nito, kolenji Samson koru eng’ kelyekyik ak koguur chito konyo kotil sumekyik. Kingong’eet Samson, ko kagobek kimnatennyi. Kobwa anyun Pilistik ak konam Samson, kobar konyekyik ak komut koek otwogindennywa.



Kiit anyun betut ne ki tinyei igoorto ne o Pilistik ne bo cheptalelinnywa ne kiguure Dagon, ak kigimut Samson komong’ eng’ korgoret si kobiit kororechi. Kiga kogoegitu sumekyik kogeny. Kolenji Samson werit ne ki namati eut: ‘Kany asabsab tolochikab koi.’ Kosa anyun Samson kosom Jehovah kimnatet ak konam tolochik. Ak komwa eng’ kutit ne o kole: ‘Kany kebegu ak Pilistichu.’ Ki mi Pilistik 3,000 igooroto, ago ki nam Samson tolochikab got, koluul got tugul ak kobar bik tugul che yaachen.Kiruogik kurgetab 13 agoi 16. Teebutik che Kineetengei

TOS ma kararan lakwani mi pichaini? Kiguure Samuel, ko chichi kanam metitab lakwani ko tisiindet ne o ne bo Israel ne kiguure Eli. Bik alak chu igeere eng’ pichaini ko baba ne bo Samuel ne kiguree Elkana ak kamennyi Hana, ichek che kaimutu Samuel konyo kotebi ak Eli.

Ki bo Samuel kenyisiek ang’wan anan ko mut kityo kimutu konyo hekalutab Jehovah ago kong’eete yoto ak kotestai, ko kimeng’is eng’ yoto ak Eli koboto tisiik alak. Ki amu nee si komach Elkana ak Hana komut lakwa ne mining’ ne u Samuel kwo koboisiechi Jehovah eng’ hekalunnyi? Ngegeer.

Eng’ kenyisiek tutigin che kiga kosiirto, ko kiimegei Hana mising’ amu ki ma komuchi kosich lakwa ago ki machei lakwet ne bo kwong’ut. Amu noto, ko mi betut agenge ne ki wo Hana gotab Jehovah ak kosa kole: ‘Ee Jehovah, mat iutyeno! Ngot igono werit, agonin si kobiit koboisieun eng’ sobennyi tugul.’

Ki wol Jehovah saetab Hana ago ma tianit kesich Samuel. Amu ki chamei Hana lakwennyi, ko kiinaam koneet agobo Jehovah ko ta koming’in mising’. Kolenji Hana manong’otiondennyi: ‘Ye eet Samuel, amuti kwo hekalut si kobiit koboisiechi Jehovah eng’ oloto.’

Nito kit ne yae Hana ak Elkana eng’ pichaini. Baibai Samuel konyo koboisiechi Jehovah eng’ emaitab Jehovah ne bo saet amu kiinet sigikyik komie. Bwanei Hana ak Elkana yuto kila kenyit konyo kosae ak korutochi lakwennywa. Kingorutochi, ko ki cham koibchin ngoriet ne leel ne ki napei Hana.

Ki testai Samuel anyun koboisiechi Jehovah eng’ hekalunnyi, ago kiboiboichi Jehovah ak bik boisiennyin mising’. Nga u noto, ko ki ma ko miachen werikab Eli che ki kiguure Hopni ak Pineas. Yae tuguk che yaach ago yae bik alak kongelelji Jehovah. Ki magat koisto Eli werikyik eng’ boisietab tisiik, ago ma yai ko u noto.

Nganda ki yaaksei tuguk che yaach eng’ gotab Jehovah, ko ma iyan Samuel koteer nito ma boisiechi Jehovah. Kiga koek keny kong’eete ngong’alalji bik Jehovah, amu ki tutigin bik che ki chamei Jehovah. Nga u noto, ko kingo kagoeet Samuel koyaak ko u ni:

Kingo ta koruei Samuel eng’ gotab Jehovah kogas chi ne ki kuurei. Kowol kole: ‘Ami yu.’ Kong’eet ak kolabat ole mi Eli ak kolenji: ‘Keguuro, ago kaanyo.’

Kowolji Eli kolenji: ‘Ma aguurin, weegen ui ru.’ Koweektagei anyun Samuel koru.

Kigas anyun kuurset ne bo aeng’ ne kile: ‘Samuel!’ Kong’eet kogeny Samuel ak kolabat kwo ole mi Eli ak kolenji: ‘Keguuro, ago kaanyo.’ Kowolji Eli kole: ‘Ma aguurin werinnyu, ui ru.’ Koweetagei anyun Samuel kogeny koru.

Kigas Samuel kuurset kogeny ne bo somok ne kile: ‘Samuel!’ Kolabat ole mi Eli ak kolenji: ‘Kaanyo, oiye keguuro ne bo ra anyun.’ Ki nai Eli anyun kole Jehovah ne kuursei. Ko u noto kolenji Samuel: ‘Ui ru, ago ngot koguurin kogeny ko magat iwolu ile: “Jehovah, mwa amu kasei kiboitiondeng’ung’.”’

Ki wol ko u noto Samuel kingo kuur Jehovah kogeny. Komwachi Jehovah anyun Samuel agobo magennyi ne bo koruokyi Eli ak werikyik. Ko u noto, kebar Hopni ak Pineas kingoba kobargei ak Pilistik ak kingo kas Eli kit ne kayaak kobut, koil katit ak kome. Kosulda anyun ng’olyot ne kigamwa Jehovah.

Ki eet Samuel ak koek kiruogindet ne bo let ne bo Israel. Kingo oosit Samuel, komwachi bik inendet kole: ‘Lewenwech laitoriat kondoiywech.’ Ki ma komachei Samuel koyai ko u noto amu eng’ iman, ko ki Jehovah laitoriandennywa. Nga u noto, kolenji Jehovah Samuel kogasyi bik kit ne mwae.1 Samuel 1:1-28; 2:11-36; 3:1-18 4:16-18; 8:4-9. Teebutik che Kiteebengei
